title: Read a JSON field
summary: T-SQL: Read a JSON field. Read $.pages. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: JSON_VALUE reads one simple value from JSON text using a path.
learningObjectives: Read a JSON field with T-SQL

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.
The path $.title selects the scalar title field from the JSON object.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use valid JSON with double-quoted field names.
